kicker: STEAL THESE FROM THE BEST MEN YOU KNOW
title: 5 qualities that make a man *hard to break*

label: QUALITY 1
head: Discipline
sub: You train on the days with no motivation and no visible results.

label: QUALITY 2
head: Calm under pressure
sub: Bad news lands. You go quiet for 10 seconds, then decide.

label: QUALITY 3
head: Humility after you win
sub: New title, same way you talk to the waiter and the cleaner.

label: QUALITY 4
head: Self-belief nobody signed off on
sub: Nobody bets on you yet. You keep showing up anyway.

label: QUALITY 5
head: Mental toughness
sub: When it gets hard, you walk toward it instead of away.

head: Pick *one* and start today
sub: You don't copy the man. You copy the habit.
